action:
After a standard system update you need to restart Kerberos to make
all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that the Kerberos KDC incorrectly handled certain ASN.1
encodings in requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause the KDC to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
(CVE-2026-107364)

It was discovered that the Kerberos KDC incorrectly handled malformed
client names in PAC data during S4U2Proxy requests. A remote attacker
controlling a trusted cross-realm KDC could possibly use this issue to
cause the KDC to crash, resulting in a denial of service. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-107708)

It was discovered that Kerberos incorrectly handled certain KRB-CRED
messages. A remote authenticated attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause services that accept forwarded credentials to crash, resulting in a
denial of service. (CVE-2026-107778)

It was discovered that the Kerberos password change service did not
enforce the lockdown_keys principal attribute. An authenticated attacker
with administrative privileges could possibly use this issue to bypass
security restrictions and change the keys of a protected principal.
(CVE-2026-107884)

It was discovered that Kerberos incorrectly handled PAC server checksum
verification. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass
security restrictions. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-111423)

It was discovered that the Kerberos GSS-RPC client did not properly free
memory when handling certain replies. A remote attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause Kerberos client programs to consume excessive memory,
leading to a denial of service. (CVE-2026-112314)

It was discovered that the Kerberos GSS-RPC library did not properly free
memory under certain circumstances. A remote attacker could possibly use
these issues to cause the Kerberos administration server to consume
excessive memory, leading to a denial of service. (CVE-2026-112315,
CVE-2026-112316, CVE-2026-112320, CVE-2026-112321)

It was discovered that Kerberos did not properly free decrypted key
material when a post-decryption check failed. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause the Kerberos KDC or administration server
to consume excessive memory, leading to a denial of service.
(CVE-2026-112317)

It was discovered that the Kerberos administration server did not properly
handle empty policy names. An authenticated attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause the Kerberos administration server to crash, resulting
in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-112318)

It was discovered that the Kerberos GSS-RPC library did not enforce size
limits when decoding data. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause the Kerberos administration server to consume excessive
resources, leading to a denial of service. (CVE-2026-112319)

It was discovered that the legacy AUTH_GSSAPI authentication flavor in the
Kerberos administration server lacked protections against resource
exhaustion. A remote attacker could possibly use these issues to cause the
Kerberos administration server to consume excessive resources, leading to
a denial of service. This update disables AUTH_GSSAPI in the Kerberos
administration server by default. It can be re-enabled by setting the
GSSRPC_ALLOW_AUTH_GSSAPI environment variable for kadmind.
(CVE-2026-112322, CVE-2026-112323)

It was discovered that Kerberos did not properly verify RPCSEC_GSS call
arguments. An attacker in a machine-in-the-middle position could possibly
use this issue to alter the arguments sent by a legitimate client to RPC
services, or cause return values to be sent in plain text.
(CVE-2026-118380)

It was discovered that Kerberos inefficiently decoded long ASN.1
sequences. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
Kerberos to consume excessive CPU resources, leading to a denial of
service. (CVE-2026-119079)

Alejandro Pacheco discovered that Kerberos did not reject unkeyed
checksums in CAMMAC verifiers. An authenticated attacker could possibly
use this issue to bypass authentication indicator requirements.
(CVE-2026-71199)

Erin Liman discovered that the Kerberos PKINIT module incorrectly handled
certain CMS messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause the KDC to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-71200)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Kerberos.
title: Kerberos vulnerabilities
